events.name: MOBILITY_UPDATED
events.description: The mobility-matrix state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: mobility update, transition matrix, immobility, rags to riches, intergenerational mobility

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: SET_CELL
events.description: Learner clicked a matrix cell to raise its transition probability by one step (wrapping past the cell max back to the cell min); the row then renormalizes to sum to 1.

events.name: TOGGLE_BENCHMARK
events.description: Learner toggled the perfect-mobility benchmark overlay (every quintile destination equally likely) on the heat grid.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner pressed Reset to restore the configured transition matrix.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Benchmark Matrix
overridableConfigKeys.description: Perfect-mobility benchmark shown by Toggle Benchmark: every child's quintile is equally likely whatever the parent's — a 0.2-uniform matrix, same flat 25-cell layout as Transition Matrix.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: perfect mobility, benchmark, equal opportunity, mobility benchmark

overridableConfigKeys.label: Cell Max
overridableConfigKeys.description: A click that would push a cell above this value wraps it back to Cell Min instead.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Cell Min
overridableConfigKeys.description: Value a cell wraps back to after passing Cell Max.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Cell Size
overridableConfigKeys.description: Pixel size of each matrix cell in the heat grid.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Cell Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: Amount added to a cell's probability on each click, before the row renormalizes.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid X
overridableConfigKeys.description: X coordinate of the heat grid's top-left corner.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid Y
overridableConfigKeys.description: Y coordinate of the heat grid's top-left corner.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Interactive
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Quintile Labels
overridableConfigKeys.description: Display names of the five income quintiles, richest to poorest; index-aligned with both matrix rows and columns.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: quintile, income quintile, social class, socioeconomic status

overridableConfigKeys.label: Transition Matrix
overridableConfigKeys.description: Flat 25-cell quintile transition matrix (5 rows of 5): row = parent's quintile, column = child's, both ordered richest to poorest as in Quintile Labels; each row sums to 1. Cell 20 (bottom→top) is the rags-to-riches rate.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: social mobility, intergenerational mobility, transition matrix, quintile, immobility, rags to riches, Great Gatsby curve
